messages.body_plain:
The following forum message was posted by tfry at http://sourceforge.net/projects/rkward/forums/forum/165574/topic/4923509:

Hi!

You are trying to use a version of RKWard compiled against R < 2.14.0 with R
>= 2.14.0. This is not going to work, and essentially that is what that dependency
error is about.

Use this PPA, instead, which provided binaries of RKWard built against R 2.14.x:
https://launchpad.net/~rkward-devel/+archive/rkward-dailys-cran .

Regards
Thomas

messages.subject: [rkward-users] first public beta for RKWard on MacOSX
messages.subject_clean: [rkward-users] first public beta for RKWard on MacOSX
messages.body_plain:
dear all,

we are proud to announce the first public beta test version or RKWard on 
MacOSX. if you have access to a Mac -- or know people who are anxious to use 
RKWard on their's --, please consider testing this release, and give us 
feedback:
 o https://sourceforge.net/projects/rkwardextras/files/MacOSX

you should find all neccessary installation notes in the README.MacOSX file.

known issues:
=============

1. the bundle is still huge (2,7 GB unpacked on your harddrive), as it comes 
with a full KDE base environment. hopefully we'll find ways to change that in 
future releases, but for the moment we're focussing on possible problems with 
RKWard itself.

2. RKWard's ususal graphics device features are still missing. graphics 
devices are therefore what you get from R directly, without the nice add-ons 
RKWard offers on GNU/linux and Windows.

apart from that, so far RKWard seems to work fine -- see for yourselves :-) 
your comments and suggestions are most welcome!
